messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Your quote reached us, and we have set out our answer so that it can go straight to your pricing committee: three options, each complete and easy to compare.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Vesmo a stable framework for the full contract term, and the volume outlook supports that.

On quality:
Your quality was 764 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70520@2026Q3).

On volume:
Our forecast for Motor IE3 4 kW, 4-pole rises 7.6% (fc:350010@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 220.69; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 219.39; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 218.75; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; Incoterm DAP.

For your pricing committee, here is a paragraph you can forward as it stands: Hollerau Pumpenwerke offers a renewal of the framework for the IE3 motor on three clear option terms. Option A gives Vesmo the longest payment-term structure and a clear contract term with a steady, forecast-backed volume outlook. If Option A is confirmed as it stands, Hollerau can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A to the approver. If your approval needs anything more from us, we will provide it promptly.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
